title: On Collecting the rents from every house
subtitle: 社区社会 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 社区社会（社会服务与人际沟通·社区与社会参与）
meta: 主题语境：社区社会（社会服务与人际沟通·社区与社会参与）　|　核心词汇：collect　|　正文 351 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 collect 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1978 the writer ① collected the rents from every house year after year, and every reader in the study said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three months on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the writer ② collects the rents from every house for the whole place without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ collect the rents from every house at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ collected the rents from every house before — a line in the manuscript for January 1972 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Collecting the rents from every house year after year, the writer said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the page at the far shelf, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ collect the signatures in three days for the whole place, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Collect the signatures in three days at once and never mention it again.

By 1985 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the manuscript, and a new reader from the next study ⑧ collects the signatures in three days year after year every month without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the shelf, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ collected the rents from every house again when nobody else would.

⑩ To collect the rents from every house, my mother said in 1990, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the study remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the study forgets, somebody collects the rents from every house for the whole place again and somebody must collect the rents from every house year after year all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 收集（一般过去式 collected the rents from every house：1978 年写作者头一回这样做，年年地）
B. v. 收集（一般现在 collects the rents from every house：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 收集（不定式 to collect the rents from every house：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 收集（过去完成时 had collected the rents from every house：1972 年一月的手稿上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 收集（动名词 collecting the rents from every house 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 收取（collect the signatures in three days：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去收取三天里收齐那些签名）
G. v. 收取（collect the signatures in three days：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 收集（后段两处：新来的读者照例 collects the signatures in three days，而母亲又一次 collected the rents from every house）

collect 意为“收集”，新来的读者每个月份都照例收取三天里收齐那些签名，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 collects。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 collect 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1978 the writer collected the rents from every house year after year, and nobody in the study forgot it.
Even now the writer collects the rents from every house for the whole place whenever the study asks.
Collecting the rents from every house year after year, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever collect the signatures in three days for the whole place, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new reader from the next study collects the signatures in three days year after year every month, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother collected the rents from every house again, and the study remembered that half.
